acquisition_method.evidence: Data was acquired in Parallel Reaction Monitoring (PRM) with one MS1 scan for every 10 PRM scans.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Cell pellets consisting of 1-2x108 cells were homogenized and lysed on ice with lysis buffer containing 1% octyl-β-D glucopyranoside, 0.25% sodium deoxycholate, 1mM EDTA, 0.2mM iodoacetamide, 1:200 Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (P8340, Sigma-Aldrich) and 1MM PMSF in PBS as previously described 63.
